Optional: Read the transcript

Welcome to Module 2. In Module 1, you learned what DeFi, wallets, smart contracts, staking, lending, token supply, RWA and security mean in general. Now we apply that knowledge to RWANFTFI. The NFT is the membership layer. DA is the protocol asset. The platform includes marketing, financial tools, governance, security, and roadmap features. Our rule is simple: understand what the system says it does before making any judgment about the result.

Understand the ecosystem story before memorizing details.
Follow the NFT → DA → platform → financial/partner → governance → roadmap flow.
Separate protocol pathways from optional referral/team rewards.
Use LIVE, TIER-GATED and ROADMAP labels to understand feature status.

📘Your Beginner Path

Complete the 20 core lessons in order. Each core lesson is intentionally short, visual and built around one recurring learner named Alex.

📘Deep Dive & Reference

Nothing from the detailed Module 2 build was deleted. Whitepaper-level mechanics, dashboard pages, tier rules and compensation details now sit underneath the core lessons as optional references.

📘The learning rhythm

Coach video → Big Idea → Alex example → Coach Rule → Risk → one-question Quick Check → optional Deep Dive.

⭐Coach's Rule

Mechanism first, percentage second. Current feature first, roadmap feature second. Protocol path and partner path stay separate.

Key Takeaways

  • 20 core lessons form the required beginner path.
  • Detailed material remains available without blocking progress.
  • Progress is measured by core lesson mastery, not by reading every reference page.

What to do next

  • Start with 2.1 What Is RWANFTFI?
  • Complete core lessons in order.
  • Open Deep Dive only when you want more technical detail.

Education & Risk — read before using real funds

This Academy is educational material, not personalized financial, legal or tax advice. Returns are not guaranteed. Digital assets and DeFi protocols can lose value, fail or be exploited; you may lose your entire investment. Start with test networks and never share a seed phrase or private key.

RWANFTFI is studied as an external project, not presented as a guaranteed opportunity or an Academy endorsement. This file does not verify a formal affiliation between the Academy and the project. Project claims, audits and roadmap items require independent review.

Planned means a proposed feature, not a live service. Optional means not required for the main course. Availability unverified means current operation has not been checked. No resource is labeled live-verified in this release.

Some project links contain a referral code. A referrer may receive compensation if you use those links. You do not need to use referral links or join a team to study the Academy.

External links and project availability have not been live-verified for this release. Check the official source and its current terms before acting.
